unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Yehoshua Heschel declares before the God-fearing congregation that he does not trust himself, and an aged maggid of Barnow, a former attendant of the Maggid Dov Ber who once saw a bow of fire over him at prayer, answers him.
unit.boundary_note: Trailing heading ': מענין אמונת צדיקים' belongs to the next division

stories.start_quote: יא) פעם אחת עמד מו״ר רבינו יהושע העשיל
stories.end_quote: שלא יסוג אחור אבל לא לאחר
stories.summary_en: R. Yehoshua Heschel says publicly that he does not trust himself even for a moment, still less the young or the old of this generation; a ninety-year-old maggid of Barnow, who had served the Maggid Dov Ber and seen a bow of fire over him during prayer, replies that he trusts himself not to backslide but would not vouch for another.
